name: Serviceberry Leafroller
desc: Serviceberry Leafroller (Olethreutes appendiceum): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 17 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Olethreutes appendiceum, the serviceberry leafroller, is a species of tortricid moth in the family Tortricidae. The MONA or Hodges number for Olethreutes appendiceum is 2821.
